title: SafeStep Terms for Returns, Exchanges and Work-Damaged Footwear
content:
# Returns, Exchanges and Work-Damaged Footwear

These terms apply to purchases redeemed under the SafeStep Safety Footwear & Eyewear Program.

## 1. Return window

An unworn item is returned or exchanged only when the return is made no later than the tier's exchange window in calendar days after the purchase date. Count calendar days starting the day after the purchase date; a return on the last day is accepted.

- **Clock start:** the purchase date of the redemption being returned, as shown in the company's own redemption record for that redemption reference.
- **Counting:** the day after the purchase date is day 1, in calendar days.
- **Comparison:** the return must be made no later than the last day of the window; a return on that last day is accepted.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical, on a tier with a 30-day window)

| Return made on | Counted day | Accepted? |
|---|---|---|
| The 29th calendar day after the purchase date | Day 29 | Yes |
| The 30th calendar day after the purchase date | Day 30, the last day | Yes |
| The 31st calendar day after the purchase date | Day 31 | No |

## 2. What a return restores

Where the tier provides that a returned purchase restores the allowance, the employer-paid portion is restored to the participant's allowance for the year of the original purchase and credited on the next employer bill; the employee-paid portion is refunded to the employee.

Example (hypothetical): a pair bought in one allowance year with an employer-paid portion of 120.00 and an employee-paid portion of 18.00, returned unworn within the window, restores 120.00 to that participant's allowance for the year of the purchase, credits 120.00 on the employer's next bill and refunds 18.00 to the employee.

## 3. Only one return per redemption

Each redemption can be returned only once. Whether a redemption has already been returned is read from the company's own records of returns against that redemption reference.

## 4. Footwear damaged at work

Footwear damaged at work within the tier's work-damage replacement period in days of purchase is replaced once without drawing on the allowance; normal wear is not work damage.
